patch_description: This crossover combines the inspiration program’s energy-ranked, diverse repaired seeds and compact archive with the current program’s LP-dual-guided move selection. It searches priced bottleneck links exhaustively for two-switches, then adds sampled general switches, rotations, and kicks to escape local basins. Candidate batches blend dual benefit and surrogate energy, with a few exploratory moves retained; this avoids spending most LP calls on a large, expensive neighborhood enumeration.
